entities.name: T3485
entities.description: EPS session management timer with value 8s (16s in WB-S1/CE mode). Used in BEARER CONTEXT ACTIVE PENDING state.

entities.name: T3486
entities.description: EPS session management timer with value 8s (16s in WB-S1/CE mode). Used in BEARER CONTEXT MODIFY PENDING state.

entities.name: T3489
entities.description: EPS session management timer with value 4s (12s in WB-S1/CE mode). Used in PROCEDURE TRANSACTION PENDING state.

entities.name: T3495
entities.description: EPS session management timer with value 8s (16s in WB-S1/CE mode). Used in BEARER CONTEXT INACTIVE PENDING state.

entities.name: BEARER CONTEXT ACTIVE PENDING
entities.description: State where timer T3485 is active during bearer context activation procedures.

entities.name: BEARER CONTEXT MODIFY PENDING
entities.description: State where timer T3486 is active during bearer context modification procedures.

entities.name: PROCEDURE TRANSACTION PENDING
entities.description: State where timer T3489 is active during ESM information request procedures.

entities.name: BEARER CONTEXT INACTIVE PENDING
entities.description: State where timer T3495 is active during bearer context deactivation procedures.

entities.name: ACTIVATE DEFAULT EPS BEARER CONTEXT REQUEST
entities.description: Message that starts timer T3485 when sent.

entities.name: ACTIVATE DEDICATED EPS BEARER CONTEXT REQUEST
entities.description: Message that starts timer T3485 when sent.

entities.name: MODIFY EPS BEARER CONTEXT REQUEST
entities.description: Message that starts timer T3486 when sent.

entities.name: ESM INFORMATION REQUEST
entities.description: Message that starts timer T3489 when sent.

entities.name: DEACTIVATE EPS BEARER CONTEXT REQUEST
entities.description: Message that starts timer T3495 when sent.
